name: Session 9 - The tourney pt2
body:
Recap / session intro
The party has made it through the first two events.

Session Overview

Event 3 - Destroy the Flag (Round 1)
- The games continue. The next event is Destroy the Flag: each team defends its own flag statue while trying to destroy the other's.
- Introducing Clueless (Phillipa), a druid with many allies, on the opposing team.
- Petra shines the flag (?). Bex moves the flag after tying the statue to her. Clueless summons a wolf, which tears the rope and releases Bex. Alaric (Tim) takes damage from Clueless's summoned bear.
- Petra casts Sleep on the bear. It works, but only for 1 round.
- The druid summons Faye. Ian stabs Faye as it passes and deals 11 damage, then Thunderwaves Clueless for 6 damage.
- Alaric dashes to the dwarf flag protector, who attacks him for 9 damage. Bex moves to face Faye, and the dire wolf is in front of Faye. Bex hits Faye with a javelin for 8 damage and Faye is slowed. Bex's bonus attack hits for 4 and the wolf bites Faye for 11.
- Petra casts Mage Armour, moves to a collapsed pillar and uses it as cover.
- Alaric takes 5 damage from the dwarf plus 6 radiant damage, then is attacked from behind for 9 damage. Clueless heals him for 23 points, back to full health.
- The other team's mage, still invisible, moves across the map and casts Fireball. Our statue is on fire and visibly cracking, and the structures are crumbling.
- Phillipa wild shapes into a lion. Ian disguises himself as an opposing team member and shoots the statue for 6 damage. Clueless's bear tries to attack Petra but misses.
- Alaric punches the flag statue, rolls a nat 20 and cracks the statue.

Event 3 - Destroy the Flag (Round 2)
- "Bad hands" (the opposing mage) moves up and targets Yat with Fireball for 17 fire damage. Yat rolls a nat 20 on the saving throw and takes half. The rope is on fire. Petra records 1 success (death saves).
- The twin blades rogue finishes a bell bomb arrow, moves and successfully hides. Double knives attacks Aerin twice. One lands for 5 damage plus 13 poison damage, then a further attack follows. Jeff jumps up onto the steps.
- While still hidden, the mind mage casts Fireball and hits both Petra and Alaric. Petra auto-fails the save. Alaric takes 8 damage. Bex puts out the fire on the rope.
- The wolf moves towards the grenade guy and bites him for 5 damage. Clueless fails a saving throw. The grenade guy throws a grenade at Bex for 20 poison damage, then fires 2 arrows for 7 damage and 12 poison, and Bex is down.
- Weird hands turns towards Alaric and the mind attack fails. Alaric moves across the map, aims a bell bomb at the statue and hits it.
- Double blades moves to Alaric and goes for 2 attacks, which fail. Twin blades moves towards Alaric, fails 2 attacks, tries another 2 and downs him.
- Jeff readies an action for Thunderwave for when the bell bomb explodes. The mind mage readies Frost Ray for when he sees someone.
- Clueless is back up. The bear moves and attacks the grenade guy for 12 damage on the 1st swipe and the 2nd fails. The grenade guy aims his bow at Clueless and misses, then throws a grenade. Clueless takes 14 damage and the bear is down. The grenade guy kills off the wolf and moves.
- Weird hands prepares a Fireball for when he sees someone. The bell bomb blows the cracked statue. Jeff's readied Thunderwave breaks the statue, and the mind mage's readied Fireball hits Ian (?), who goes down. The flag is destroyed and the ducks win the match for us. Petra dies.
- Last round Petra is a ghost. Jeff moves and fails to hide. Aerin shoots an arrow and does a damage. Clueless casts Cure Wounds for 21 HP. Alaric dashes to the bridge, fire lights an arrow and fires it at the statue (4 piercing damage). Yat moves, takes a health potion and lays on hands. Further attack rounds follow on the statue:
- Statue damage in this exchange (as written, P = piercing, F = fire, D = damage): 6 fire, 7 piercing, 6 fire, 4, 6 piercing and 9 fire, 7 fire, 7 piercing (Jeff's flaming throwing javelin), 8 piercing and 1 fire, 6 and 9, 5 fire, 8 piercing.
- Yat attacks Jeff and downs him, then attacks again (Alaric takes 14 damage). Clueless casts Fire Bolt at the statue. A hidden opponent moves and takes a shot.
- Yat fumbles off the bridge and takes damage from her own axe. Clueless is targeted with a javelin from the opposing team and goes down. Stuff happens. The opposing team's remaining members are then destroyed or down, and the opposing team concedes. No one else dies.
- We win the comp and receive 1 terracotta heart for the team. The team thanks Petra and leaves, then they pay for Petra's revival...

Event 4 - Destroy the Flag (Rematch)
- Dire wolf bites and kills Faye. Yat moves with the wolf and partially hides. Petra fails Thunderwave against the wizard but takes 5 damage. The bear takes 10 damage. Clueless fails an attack against Ian (?), and the bear attacks and throws her against a pillar for 4 damage.
- The statue is hit with a nat 20 and close to 20 damage, taking a gouge out of it. Lee enters the ring and Thunderwaves, causing 7 damage. Two team mates take full damage and the ducks take half. The statue is destroyed and the flag is on the floor.
- Lee burns the flag and we win.
- Yat asks for boots to be enchanted with Misty Step in the future.

Enchanting notes
- An enchanting kit is needed. It can use known spells or a spell scroll to craft, but will need enchanting ink.
- To make a spell scroll needs parchment and enchanting ink. Without a scroll, it needs the kit and uses my manor and 1 spell slot.
- There is a chance to fail the craft, but Petra has advantage because of Magic Study. If successful, gain XP. If it fails, a higher chance of success next turn, to be decided by dice roll.

Event 5 - Destroy the Flag (Wounded opponent)
- Next round the wounded opponent fails to hit the statue with a flaming arrow, so gives up and we win by default.

Event 6 - Destroy the Flag (Full team vs. Full team)
- Next round, full opponent team. Clueless joins our team.
- Jeff shoots the statue for 11 damage. Bad1 hides behind a pillar. Lee moves and takes a shot at Bad1 with a grenade but misses.
- Yat prepares to climb the arena after tying the statue with rope, and climbs the walls. Clueless moves and summons Faye. Ian moves behind the bridge and is in sight of the enemy archer, who downs him with 2 hits, the second of which is poisoned.
- Petra dashes over, slides and crouches out of sight, ready to administer a healing potion. Alaric moves to hide behind a pillar.
- Twin blade moves and goes for an attack on Clueless, who takes 8 damage and 10 poison damage. Baddie hands downs Clueless and Faye goes.
- Splinter moves, tries to throw a dagger at Petra but kills himself with a dagger to the foot that was coated with poison. Aerin moves up and casts Ray of Frost at twin blades for 8 cold damage. Twin blades takes a shot at Bad1 for 8 damage.
- Yat ties off on a spiky turnip-looking thing and gently pulls off the podium, and is now 5ft off the ground. Bad1 moves. Petra heals Jeff for 8 HP. Alaric moves and continues assembling the bell bomb.
- Twin blades moves. Double stabby moves and goes for an attack on Aerin but has disadvantage: 11 damage and ? poison damage. Twin blades takes a shot at Bex but misses. Ian rises and Aerin swings stealthily.
- Mage guy fails a mind attack on Aerin. Aerin swings with a war pick in hand and attempts an attack on the bridge, but just bumps into him and lands on a flaw.
- Yat ties a knot, but the statue cannot hit the ground now and struggles to pull up this round. It will be Yat's turn next round.
- Clueless rolls a nat 20 on a saving throw. The grenade guy throws a 19 piercing damage grenade between Alaric and Petra, and they both fail to save (12 poison). Petra is down. He then shoots 2 arrows at Petra for 8 damage.

name: Session 8 - The tourney pt1
body:
Recap / session intro
Lee to provide

Session Overview

- 07:30 Jeff met with Myra. After catching up Myra eludes to her reason for being in Horizon's Landing. A job, she is going to set up a betting pool on the tournament trying to get people to bet against her chosen competitor. Her grouo will then rig the fight in favour of her champion. Jeff agrees to convince one of his party Alaric to join tournament. Myra will give Jeff 50gp if the play is sucessful. Additionakky her group will be working the crowd.
- Earlier that morning Petra received a letter delivered by her familiar (name transcribed as "Clerk") — the letter was from her mage mentor Algris and included a map marking the locations of various gems.
- The party come down to an inn full of passed out drunks.
- Alaric stealths over to a very drunk possibly rich guy, gets pricked by a needle but gets the guys purse.
- Alaric ran to an chemist and got told hed been jabbed with steroids, he volunteered his blood for resting.
- The party went to the Horizion's Landing - Guildhall where Tessa Evergreen gave all a hard time for not reporting last night. Yat threw Jeff up the stairs towards her where she hit him with a handbag back to the bottom of the steps.
- The party reported completion of the quest and got 90 gold as a reward.
- The party also received 15gp for turning in a separate completed quest.
- The party looked at the board for more quests and saw a lot of urgent ones.
- Aerin sent Skye to look for a missing apprentice clerk.
- The party agreed to provide escort for a peace summit next week.  The escort job for the peace talk summit agreed to above was detailed further: a 3-day job paying 50gp, plus a 10% discount from a fabric merchant.
- The party decided to partake in the games, and make their way towards the Horizion's Landing - Arena.
- While in the crowd, a cloaked figure bumped into Petra. She followed and spotted a group of cloaked pickpockets heading toward the market place, with guards also heading that way, trailing another group of cloaked figures. Jeff's familiar (a shapeshifter, "forever-changing" while in its cloaked form) watched other cloaked figures slip into the sewer pipes with guards in pursuit. The original cloaked figure noticed this, turned around, and walked off the other way. Pax (?) tried to distract him while Jeff attempted to pick his pocket — the attempt failed, Jeff was noticed, and was warned off: this was his turf.
- The party made their way to the arena to catch up with the rest of the team in time for the Boat Battle.
- Alaric pays for the parties entry to all events over the weekend and bribes the registration clerk to find out more about the competitions and competitors.  She points us to a bookmaker for better guidance.
-
- Event 1 Boat battle. (2nd place)
- The first battle is against the ship workers, it becomes a much more marshal battle where the party end up rendering the opposition unconscious while simultaneously puncturing their boat and setting it on fire. Aerin took a paddle to the face and was floored for a moment.
- Second round, the party tied Alaric to a rope, grapple the top of the dividing wall and then tied the end to the boat and paddled away. This yeeted Alaric over the wall, at the apex of his arc he transformed into his giant form and decended onto the opponents boats, immediately sinking it.
- For the final round, Alaric in his giant form picked up the boat and raced around with it to the finish line. Just before he put the boat down,  an explosive he had on his person ruptured and exploded, destroying the boat. This caused the party to be disqualified.
- Following the match Jeff saw someone running away from the arena and went to follow, Alaric investigated his backpack arms saw the remnants of a magical effect that prevented the rest of his combustables from exploding.
- Event 2 Feed the sharks. - 1st place
- Navigating pillars to win was more simple than the crowd and organisers expected, the match was won quickly by Petra who misty stepped to the winning podium while the party dislodged the opponents into the water.
- Yat also chose the moment of our win to vacate her bowels.
- Feed the Sharks round 2 (final): Jeff misty stepped, and a teammate ( Yat) relieved themselves in the water mid-match — the party's win was announced.
- Following the win, the crowd headed out to the feast.  The menagerie included a number of creatures one of which was an empty cage labeled as a manticore. Petra went to look at it too.
- The party took a short rest and recovered a spell slot, but there were no more freebies on offer.
- Margin note on placements: 1st (Feed the Sharks), 2nd (Boat Battle, disqualified).

name: Session 6 - Orge Cave Raid
body:
Session Overview

This is what happened!

Events
- wake in the tavern
- Head to the adventurers guild
- Tessa Evergreen meets them on the steps of the guild
- Tessa introduces the party to the adventurers that will be joining them on this quest. Milo Thistlewick, Cade Willowmere, Perrin Ashfoot, Henrietta
- As Alaric is preparing to brief the team, Ser Gillard arrives in the adventurers guild.
- Once the team has been briefed by Alaric they discuss a plan of attack. (I think this worked well. Will try to encourage more of it)
- The Party then set off for The kingswood.
- On the hunting trail in the woods, the scouts Milo Thistlewick and Perrin Ashfoot report finding a Brown Bear caught in a trap.
- The group decided to encounter the bear.
- Alaric attempts to tame it but with little success.
- Ser Gillard then makes an attempt using food as a medium to try and calm it. He is successful.
- The bear is released from the trap.
- Yat heals the bear.
- Ser Gillard tames the bear and names it Fish.
- The party proceed to the Ogre cave, there they find 2 patrolling ogres.
- Once there the halflings draw off one of the Ogre.
- Alaric uses an illusion to draw off another.
- The party then get into position around the cave entrance.
- Yat, Petra hide behind a boulder outside the cave entrance. Ser Gillard and fish stand off to the side. The rest of the party are stood on top of the mound into which the cave is hollowed.
- Alaric drops a container of run down one of the vents. This alerts the Ogre to the presence of people outside.
- An Ogre emerges from the cave.
- The Ogre spots Fish and sweeps him aside.
- Ser Gillard charges in, swinging wildly only to be crushed under the mass of the ogre collapsing on him.
- The rest of the party hurl javelins or arrows into the Ogre.
- The Ogre dies atop Ser Gillard
- A second and third Ogre emerges from the cave.
- The second Ogre charges at Petra and Yat. It trips over a bolder, Petra manages to dodge out of the way but Yat ends up trapped under it.
- A lumbering beast emerges from the cave.
- Aerin jumps from the ledge above the cave onto the beast.
- Henrietta slaughters the beast that had fallen onto Yat
- Alaric does a flip over the beast, and slides beneath the beast into the cave slashing at the beasts belly as he went.
- Aerin gets thrown from the beast into the cave.
- Petra creates a sphere of fire under the beast.
- Yat is aided to her feet by Henrietta.
- Ser Gillard riding atop Fish charges at the beast. He leaps from bear to beast and smashes his foot through the beasts head, killing it dead.
- The party loot the Ogres and beast. Ser Gillard breaks one of his knives attempting to skin an Ogre but eventually succeeds.
- Ser Gillard gifts the Ogre skin to Alaric
- The beasts blood appears to be eating a hole into the floor, which the beast eventually falls through.
- The party choose to go down and see what is in the hole (The party have stumbled into floor 1 Kingswood- Guardians rest). Henrietta decides to stay with Fish and wait for the halflings.
- The group find themselves in a chamber, the walls lined with books and the remains of the beast dissolving the table in the centre of the room.
- Alaric looks through the bookshelves until he discovers one unlike the rest. He can see a faint glow coming from it. He takes that book.
- The party light torches and begin to progress into the ruins.
- They come across a locked door. After trying it, most of the party proceed down a secondary corridor. Alaric holding the book he found, places a hand on the door but feels no resistance where the door should be. He pushes forward only to pass through the door.
- After a moment, Alaric pops his head back through the door, grabs Ser Gillard and Petra before pulling them through the door after him.
- Jeff, Yat and Aerin continue exploring the corridors, but progress is limited due to collapsed sections.
- Alaric, Ser Gillard and Petra find a room containing a glowing green crystal and an altar of some kind.
- Alaric and Ser Gillard touch the gem and end up inside it.
- On looking around they see what appears to be the bedroom. one wall is lined with books, the opposite a series of display cases. Opposite the bed a lit fire flickers. Two chairs and a coffee table are positioned in front of the fire.
- Alaric looks through the bookshelves and finds a green book that resonates with the one he found earlier.
- Alaric and Ser Gillard then look at the contents of the display cases.

name: Session 5 - Aftermath
summary: The party are forced to deal with the consequences of their actions during battle with the Lord of the harvest
body:
Session Overview

This is what happened!

Session intro
During the last session, Horizon's Landing was visited by the Lord of the harvest. Whilst under the effects of his presence you were involved in the deaths of a number of the towns folk. By the end of the session, you had ended the threat and as a result Horizon's Landing landing became the first town in recorded history to not be completely consumed after his visit. (Everyone has gained a historic inspiration). Whilst the town survived,  The event has taken its toll,  327 people died and many more have yet to be located.

For the last three days the party have been kept in total isolation in the city dungeon.
Have the players recap last session as if it was an interrogation.

Investigation concluded, they will not be punished  for the incident and in fact will be released. The guard advises them to leave town. Many of the residents are grieving and the guards are not certian they can ensure the parties safety.

The city is in a mix of mourning, either and confusion as the population surges,  visitors from across the continent arrive for the championships only to find a number of vendors completely closed.

87 missing (all elves or those involved with the slave trade. No elves left in the city.)
- tavern is closed - Alara Briarsong is among the missing (clues in room), Alice is dead.
- Jeweler is empty - the store appears to of been cleared out, not rushed.
- Weaponsmith is dead (skeleton in the temple)
- Temple is busy with funerals. Dead held in crypt.
- The city is in a weird state. The locals mourning the deaths of friends and family are almost outnumbered by the visitors (for the competition).
- These 2 groups are at odds. The families want to grieve the visitors want to celebrate.
- Mass funerals are being conducted.

Create a list of missing. Tea stain.

Letter arrives for Petra - invite to wizards tower (if nadine is prepared for campfire session.
Lee + bex hear the voice of the soul trapped in any soul coins they posses. (Source of voice is unknown to them).

Events
- The filthy casuals are released from the Horizion's Landing - Fort Horizon.
- Petra disguises the party so that they are not identified whilst walking through town.
- They head to the Horizion's Landing - Cathedral
- a queue to enter the cathedral extends week beyond the steroids leading up but the group avoid it by talking with a progeny and being showed to the side entrance.
- outside the group are lead to the office of the head of the clergy here in horizons landing, Freya Ravenwood
- her office had a clothes rack on the left infront of which Freya Ravenwood was standing, preparing her outfit for the funeral service. On the right are a series of plinths (Necklace of Fireballs (6 Beads), a Shield with them house ravenwood banner emblazoned on it, a series of white gems surrounding a pure white cloth (Ravenwood armor)). The back of the room is lined with bookcases.
- Freya recounts her reflection of the Enderby of the Lord of the harvests visit.
- Aerin reveals that they interacted with the Lord of the harvest. Radiant damage created by Aerin caused the Lord of the harvest to reveal himself,  though the party don't know why.
- Freya ponders for a moment before going to the bookshelf and retrieving a dusty tome.
- Freya Ravenwood examines the history of the Aasimar in Aleucia. The book is in Abyssal (and encrypted so the text appears to be moving for anyone not trained to read it.)
- The party ask to pay their respects to the dead and are lead down to the crypt by the page boy.
- Inside the crypt the soul coins react to proximity to their bodies.
- Yat follows her coin and releases it above the corpse. The coin floats, spinning above the body of Octavia.
- The page boy is sent to get the head priest.
- On seeing the soul coin, and after a brick moment of stunned silence,  he orders the body be placed on a cat and brought to the ritual chamber.
- Jeff also follows his coin to the corpse and the brings it to the ritual chamber.
- In the ritual chamber the purist begins the Resurrection spell.
- The party asks the page boy what to expect from the spell but he has never seen the ritual before so is uncertain.
- the party wait for the spell to complete (1 hour)
- Octavia is resurrected. As it turns out she did in the market place at the hands of Aerin. She did not react well to seeing him.
- She claims do of seen tendrils on the party members and was simply attempting to remove them.
- It would seem that the party party aren't going to get much more out of her. So the priest ushers the page, to take her upstairs to meet with Freya Ravenwood.
- The party then decided it's time for them to leave and so headback upstairs.
- They redisguise themselves before exiting
- They head towards the weaponsmith and discover it locked with the weaponsmith favourite weapon missing. (Found by Yat in the previous session along with the body of Throgar Bronzehelm).
- they then move to the jewellers only to find it.Cleaned out all of the jewellery has been removed and only a couple of empty boxes remain on the floor. (Yuevette Knottingly is with the other elves on the boat leaving.)
- having, no luck, they decide to head to Horizion's Landing - The Velvet Sail, which they find empty.
- The party had up to Alara Briarsong's room, only to find it empty other than the clothes she had been wearing scattered over the bed.
- the party notice some of the floor boards have been ripped up. Underneath was an now empty chamber.
- On apparently striking out the party decided to head to the Horizion's Landing - Guildhall.
- After briefly reviewing a couple of quests on the board, the party are approached by Tessa Evergreen. They decide to register as a party. And i've shown to Illithor.
- They registered under the party name Team biscuit.
- Jeff asks the guild staff about jasper knottingly. He discovers he was part of a 2 man party with Sir plopington the second and that their last quest was almost a month ago.
- The pick up 3 quests: Lighthouse resupply,  Herb gathering,  and monster turf war.
- The party then proceed to correct the cat from the Wainwright. They head out of town following the path west.
- as they pass the woodlands several beasts emerge from the woods, they are being chased by Ogre.
- Aerin and Alaric loose several arrows into the ground in front of the ogres.
- The Ogre realising that they are outside of their turf, decide to turn back.
- Petra offers up some food in an attempt to tame the beasts.
- The beasts take the food and attempt to also take her arm.
- Petra triggers sparks to spit from her fingers, startling the wolves.
- the wolves return to the forest.
- The party continues on towards the lighthouse.
- The cart wheels get stuck in the mud. Whilst attempting to push it out Aerin falls on his face becoming covered in mud.
- The party approach the lighthouse and see a large number of footprints coming to and from the light house.  An empty cat sits outside the lighthouse.
- The party are greeted by the lighthouse keeper.
- He goads Aerin into jumping off the cliff, in order to clean off the mud.
- The party have a look around and climb the tower to enjoy the view.
- Alaric helps unload the cart.
- The party switches carts and begin the return journey.
- on the road, they pass a woman dragging a doe on a sledge heading towards the lighthouse.
- The party stop at the woodlands and venture in.
- Petra collects Vesperbells.  Alaric attempts to find the Ogre lair.
- Aerin returns to the cart after 1 hour, only to discover a wolf exiting the back of the cart.
- He chases it off before returning to the cart to confirm what it was after. Several boards had been ripped up.
- under the floor boards there appeared to be some sort of concealed storage area.
- Aerin attempted to break in but was ultimately unsuccessful.
- unfortunately in his attempts to gain entry he broke on of the main sports door the rear of the carriage.
- He goes to locate suitable pieces of wood. Finding many acceptable pieces that could be used to reinforce the cart.
- Whilst repairing the cart Aerin accidentally finds this wax sealed package blazened with the oak leaf seal.
-  Meanwhile, Alaric finds an Ogre and tries to sneakily follow it.
- Alaric finds the ogre den which currently had 3 ogres inside.
- as Alaric attempts to le a very but finds himself in the path of an approaching Ogre.
- alaric managed to avoid the beast and make his way back to the cart.
- the rest of the group were already assembled and waiting.
- On route back to Horizon's Landing The party try to figure out what the package contained. Unfortunately none of them could make heads or tails of it.
- The guards allowed the party swift access to horizions landing.
- At the cartwright Jeff crashes the cart as he attempts to park it.
- The noise woke the Wainwright.
- The Wainwright meets the party, thanks them for their work, and marks the quest as complete.
- Aerin threatens the Wainwright for making them complicit in the smuggling of goods. The Wainwright pleeds ignorance.
- The party returns to the tavern for the night. Alaric sneaks out to retrieve the package.
- The party had to the guild where Aerin reports the package, the cat switch and recommends investigating the Wainwright.
- the party then go to the herbalist to turn in the Vesperbells.

name: Session 4 - Halloween special
summary: Horizons landing is under assault from the lord of the harvest.
body:
Session Overview

- The party arose to an orange Sky.
- once the party reached the bar downstairs that entered to find the tavern full.
- Alice the bar wench was stood near one of the tables.
- Petra entered the bar area first.
- After a quick look around she noticed that Alara Briarsong was cowering behind the bar.
- she asked Alara Briarsong what was wrong.  Alara pointed to the patrons and said look.
- after some further prompting,  Petra noticed that everyone else in the bar looked and added weirdly.
- Petra urges Alara Briarsong to hide upstairs. She passes the others as she exits the room.
- Aerin remembers a children's tale about a town becoming ghouls over night.
- Petra moves to the centre of the room. several of the ghouls approached her, reaching their arms towards her.
- she uses a spell to get their undivided attention, then leads them into the kitchen.
- Petra puts 3/5 of them to sleep and seals the rest of them in the room but traps herself in the pantry.
- Alaric Reveals opens tbe door and fires an arrow through the door into the ghoul Alice.
- Yat throws her spear with gusto, straight into a barrel.

Petra opens the Doors
Alaric tried and failed.
Skye is effected as well.
Aerin goes into steal.
They all head outside
Head to the guild hall.
There are no defenders outside.
Market Square.
Aerin dashed to the centre and lit up like a Christmas tree.
Lord of the harvest appears in place of the statue.
Alaric fires an arrow at the Lord of the harvest.
Lord of the harvest syphon the souls out of the nearest villagers into the lantern.
Aerin runs up the leg of the Lord of the harvest at slices at his arm.
Alaric shoots an arrow at the lantern but it passes straight through its ethereal form.
Aerin unleashes a Thunderwave.
Alaric
Each character received one soul coin.
Lord of the harvest uses misty step to vanish from view.
The filthy casuals run to the Horizion's Landing - Cathedral, where there appears to be a barricade outside.
The clergy provides shelter and access to the underground waterways.
Together The filthy casuals identify a possible location of the cultists.
The filthy casuals work their way through the waterways to the Horizion's Landing - Temple Ruins within Horizon's Landing.
They emerge in a courtyard just below the Horizion's Landing - Temple Ruins.
They approach the ruins where several monsters are standing guard.
Rather than fight the monsters, Yat successfully persuades the cultists to let them in.
They follow the cultist past the guards and into the ruins.
After exporting the entrance room they followed the cultist onto the teleportation platform.
They are teleported into a cell where the corpse of Throgar Bronzehelm is slumped.
Alaric picks the lock.
Cultist approaches the cell
Aerin intimidates the cultist into fleeing
Jeff disguises as a cultist and leads the rest of the group along the corridor.
As they work their way along the corridor a trap is triggered causing the statue to charge down the corridor.
Yat, Petra, and Alaric are thrown back into the wall.
Jeff stumbles into a guard and convinces them to attack the rest of the party.
As the guard turns his back to go after the rest of the group, Jeff attacks killing the cultist.
The group work their way through the passageway avoiding the still moving statue.
They kill 3 cultists on their way through the dungeon.
Jeff enters the final room first, walking to the centre of the cultists and unleashing a thunderwave.
They kill all but one of the cultists that had summoned the Lord of the harvest.
The last living cultist is interrogated before they consume a soul coin and transform into a Pit Fiend.
During the interrogation the party discover that the cultists are acting on the orders of Malikar. Leader of the Vaelthari.
The Pit Fiend disappears into a portal.
Placed the body of one of the cultists on the altar.
The Lord of the harvest is pleased to be released from their control and gifts the group 1 soul coin before returning to his realm. (ending the harvest in the city above)
The group stop feeling the effects of the mind altering state they had been under.

During the harvest:
362 people died.
291 are missing.
82 are completely forgotten by the townsfolk (including the tavern owner and jeweler)
Horizion's Landing - Jewelry shop is now completely vacant.

Some of the .

name: Session 3 - Horizon's landing
summary: The filthy casuals arrive in horizons landing
body:
Session Overview

This is what happened!
Events
- Yat Sparta kicks one of the wounded pirates off the ship.
- The pirate kicked overboard is slowly devoured by sharks while screaming in agony.
- Yat throws a dagger at the pirate killing them. They sink to the depth
- The other pirates are now terrified of Yat.
- Alaric shoots an arrow connected to a string at the sharks (the ones that were chewing on the pirate).
- The shark struggles against the arrow.
- Aerin Attempts to help Alaric.  But the shark manages to escape. Aerin and Alaric topple onto the deck.
- The Blood Pirates first mate is called Marcus.

summary: The filthy casuals escape from the forgotten isle
body:
Session Overview

This is what happened!

Events

After rest

- 2 Creature footprints and 3 baboon prints heading east
- Yat dodges shit throw by baboon, hits the tree and splatters over Aerin's arms.
- Yat now has a friendly baboon?
- Alaric gets hit in the nuts by a rock from nowhere. Aerin chortles to himself
- Alaric cast burning hands on inside of tower, visible from distance.
- Alaric approached The blood pirates stronghold pretending to be Alaric captain of the 7 seas. After blagging his way into a meeting with the pirate captain, Alaric struck a wager for a ship and crew. The wager a champions fight to the death. Alaric accidentally nominated Aerin.
- Loric is The Blood Pirates champion.
- The fight continued for a while until Aerin set Loric on fire, despite many attacks Loric seemed unfazed but the crowd began to change their support in favour of Aerin.
- At some point, "captain blood" turned out to be 3 parrots in a trench coat. Following this revelation and the parrots departure from the captains box, Alaric pulls the a leaver releasing some beasts into the arena. With the fight disrupted, Loric and Aerin decide to cease attacking each other and deal with the creatures. Steve and Petra join in defeating 3 of them. With the creatures contained and Loric feeling worse for wear (presumably) he offers a truce and Aerin accepts after jeering the crowd. Loric, Petra, Steve and Aerin retreat to Loric's quarters below the arena.
- Aerin is still, incredibly pissed off at Alaric.
- Loric gave access to a chest full of potions and gold, and one weirdly light feeling dagger.
- He also offered to come and aid in battle if we call for him.
- The group then headed to the  tavern for rum and roasted baboon.
- At the tavern Yat shared a plan to get off the island by stealing the recently repaired ship. She had locked some of the pirates away (x12 This accidentally included the crew of the ship they planned to steal.) and wanted to do the same with the tavern.
- Unfortunately, before the plan could be put into motion, Captain blood arrived so they went ahead with it anyway.
- Alaric pulled captain rank to clear the dock of observers and Aerin charmed the stronger guy on board to help us rig the ship and set sail.
- Petra had wondered off to the dock where Captain blood's ship had docked. Whilst their Skye delivered a message that the rest of the party had acquired a ship and were preparing to depart.
- To avoid suspicion Petra hid among the pirates unloading Captain blood's ship. She took a crate and followed the pirates as they headed for their stash. As she passed the dock on which their ship was moored she slipped away.
- Not long after the ship had slipped its moorings an alarm is raised and Captain blood grabs a few guys to man his ship and pursue us.
- Jeff found a small barrel of gunpowder below deck and suggested created a sea mine.
- Alaric fired a smoke arrow into a guy on bloods ship that obscured our actions.
- We crafted the seas mine, skye loosened their rigging control lines to slow their approach.
- I fired an arrow trailing a rope into the bow of the enemy ship. Once it hits the rope was pulled through and the improvised mine was dragged straight to context with the ship bow.
- The explosion effectively destroyed the ships bow, a huge hole now letting in significant water and the ship begins to sink.
- Yat orders the port anchor dropped and our ship turns hard to align the loaded cannons to fire. The further hits confirm the ship is sinking.
- Petra cast sleep on blood and the first mate surrenders.
- Pirates are taken captive
- Tim decapitates Captain blood and takes his signet ring along with a sealed wax package.

name: Session 1 - The forgotten Isles
summary: The filthy casuals session 1 - The forgotten Isles
body:
Session intro
The storm came with no warning.
One moment, the sky was clear, the sea a mirror of sunlight and calm. The next, black clouds rolled over the horizon like a warhost, swallowing the sky. Winds howled like banshees, tearing sails and snapping ropes, and monstrous waves rose from the deep, each one threatening to crack your ship in two.
You remember the panic, the shouts of the crew, the lightning that struck the mast. And then... the fall. Cold water. Darkness.
You wake to the screech of gulls and the lapping of waves against sand.
The taste of salt clings to your tongue. Your backpack is missing and the remainder of your gear is waterlogged but intact. Around you lie splintered boards—remnants of your vessel—and the unconscious or groaning forms of your companions. The sea stretches endlessly behind you, and ahead, a dense wall of jungle breathes with the humid pulse of life.
You're on an island—but not one you've ever seen charted. The beach is narrow, hemmed by steep cliffs on one side and thick, shadow-choked trees on the other. Strange footprints dot the wet sand—three-toed, clawed, and fresh. Somewhere in the trees, something lets out a guttural, warbling cry.
There is no sign of your crew. No ship. No way back.
But there is something watching from the treeline.
Welcome to the Isle of the Forgotten.

Session Overview
The party find themselves shipwrecked on a mysterious island shrouded in mist. In thier attempt to find a way out they stumble into ancient ruins, a pirate cove, and a dreamy dried.
